title: Verbs of the Mind
label: ch:pt-mind-verbs
canDo: I can say that I think, understand, read and write in Portuguese, produce the broken row ler shares with ver, and name the English words each of the four verbs left behind.

payoff.summary: The chapter's last lesson closes the set: after escrever the reader produces all four first-person forms in one run - penso, entendo, leio, escrevo - names escrito as the Latin scriptum, and re-derives the propped-up e- that turned scribere into escrever and stare into estar.
